description:
Cast Curious Forager by paying {0} due to Aluren.
When Curious Forager enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it, as it is a food due to Ygra.
Ygra and Curious Forager trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Curious Forager trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
